description: Conformance vectors for Junjo permission resolution. Every implementation (server, SDK local resolvers) must pass all of them. Entry keys and check permissions are given as written by a caller; implementations normalize them exactly as they would on write and on check. 'via' is the role id that decided a role-sourced result. Membership and status gating are out of scope here: every case describes one active member. Optional fields add contexts: a case's 'contexts' is the game's permissions.contexts, a role's 'contextEntries' and a member's 'contextOverrides' list contextual entries, a check's 'context' is the check's context and 'decidedContext' the result's expected 'context' (absent means the result has none); 'contextConfigs' and 'entryContexts' are validation vectors. README.md beside this file documents every field.
